onboarding.tagline: A focus timer that rewards you for putting your phone down.
onboarding.languageHint: You can change this later in the app.

tutorial.p1Body: Lay it flat, screen up, and focus. As long as it stays still, your session keeps growing.
tutorial.p2Body: Every finished session earns droplets. Give your flower enough water and it blooms.
tutorial.p3Body: Every bloom is kept in your collection — and there’s always another flower to discover.
tutorial.p4Body: Want an evening with friends, not phones? Start a Together session and grow bouquets you can only earn as a group.
tutorial.p5Title:
Put your phone down.
Grow something beautiful.
tutorial.p5Body: Your first flower is waiting on Home.

home.noPlantBody: Pick one to start growing. Grow it to full bloom and it joins your collection.

plants.intro: Small flowers bloom in a session or two. The big ones ask for a season of focus. Every bloom joins your collection.
plants.confirmSwitchBody: Your current water progress will be lost if you switch plants. You'll have to start again with the new plant.
plants.daisyBlurb: The quickest bloom there is. A gentle first step.
plants.hibiscusBlurb: Bold and warm. Opens after a few calm sessions.
plants.camelliaBlurb: Soft, layered petals that reward a little patience.
plants.marigoldBlurb: A burst of sunlight, grown over a steady week.
plants.gerberaBlurb: Bright and cheerful, for a longer run of focus.
plants.peonyBlurb: Lush and generous. A true test of stillness.
plants.dahliaBlurb: The rarest bloom. A whole season of quiet focus.
plants.sweetPeasBlurb: A little bunch for a first evening together.
plants.gardenBouquetBlurb: A whole garden, gathered by everyone who stayed.
plants.roseBouquetBlurb: An hour and a half of shared quiet, tied with string.
plants.peonyBouquetBlurb: The rarest bouquet. Two full hours, phones down, together.

duration.intro: Longer sessions earn more water — pick how long you'll focus.

session.resultNoDroplets: You didn't earn any droplets this time.
session.readySubtitle: Set the phone down, then let stillness do the rest.
session.readyStep1: Lay it flat, screen facing up
session.readyStep2: Leave the screen on — don't lock it
session.readyStep3: Picking it up ends your session

together.title: Together
together.heroBody: Spend the evening with each other, not your screens. Lay your phones down side by side and grow a bouquet you can only earn as a group.
together.namePlaceholder: What do your friends call you?
together.hostBody: Get a code to share with the people around you.
together.joinBody: Got a code from a friend? Enter it here.
together.offlineBody: Together needs an internet connection. Solo sessions still work as usual.
together.unconfiguredBody: Group sessions switch on once the Firebase config is added. Solo sessions work as usual.
together.exclusiveBody: These bouquets never bloom in solo sessions. Keep every phone down for the full time to earn one.
together.errorNotFound: No session found with that code.
together.errorGeneric: Couldn’t reach your friends. Check your connection and try again.
together.errorName: Add your name first, so friends know who’s here.
together.shareMessage: Put your phone down with me on ZenBalance 🌱 Join with code {code}
together.waitingForFriends: Share the code — friends appear here as they join.
together.leadInHint: Lay your phone flat, screen up. Your shared plant starts growing in
together.keepAlive: Everyone stays still, the plant stays alive.
together.diedHint: No bouquet this time. Try again — phones down, all the way to the end.
together.completeBody: You grew a new flower together.
together.completeBodyRepeat: You grew it together again — it’s already in your collection.
together.verifyFailed: Couldn’t reach the group to confirm. Check your connection.
together.internetRequired: Needs an internet connection on every phone

collection.title: Collection
collection.subtitle: Every flower you’ve grown, in one place.
collection.emptyHint: Grow a flower to full bloom on Home and it will be kept here, forever.
collection.revealBody: This flower has been added to your collection.
collection.revealBodyRepeat: Grown again — it’s already in your collection.
